summary:
Iter-57 live-HTTP regression on preview (align-report.preview.emergentagent.com) after the backend split (server.py -> core/auth/joint_helpers/admin_routes/integrations/cron_jobs; court_workflow _statement_routes+_submit_routes; legal_lens LensStore/lens_data; court_messages.Threads; court_packets combined_pdf/record_response). New test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter57_refactor_regression.py exercises the moved routes: 26 passed / 4 skipped / 0 failed. iter56 court walkthrough re-run: 7/7 passed. Frontend Playwright smoke confirms /samples/legal-lens-report renders the three scale tables (lens-individual-scale-a, lens-individual-scale-b, lens-scale-table), /court/sample renders court-legal-scale + court-legal-growth-progress-a ('1 of 3 growth areas met (33%)') and -b ('2 of 3 growth areas met (67%)'), and /auth loads with email+password inputs.

Coverage by area:
- Auth (auth.py): register (professional), login cookie, /auth/me, /me/preferences GET+PUT (weekly_summary toggle round-trip), /auth/refresh, /auth/logout re-issues 401 on /auth/me. /auth/forgot-password returns 200 without leakage for an unknown email.
- Public (server + samples): /api/health build=2026-09-22.1; /api/joint/sample-legal-lens/pdf application/pdf; /api/court-dashboard/sample-case, /api/joint/samples, /api/assessment-types all 200.
- Cron (cron_jobs._cron_accept, Bearer token): 6/6 endpoints return 200 {ok:true} with Authorization: Bearer $WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET and JSON body; wrong secret -> 401 on all 6; no secret -> 401.
- Integrations (integrations.check_integration_key, header X-Integration-Key): /integrations/case-invite/{bad} with correct key -> 404; without header -> 401. /external/link as authenticated professional -> 200.
- Court messages (court_messages.Threads, field name is 'text'): judge POST /court-dashboard/cases/{ref_id}/messages then pro GET /professional/court-referrals/{ref_id}/messages returns the message; reverse direction also works.
- Court packets (court_packets service, moved combined_pdf/record_response): full happy-path creation via /joint/reports/{rid}/court-packets on a completed case (finalized legal lens) returns 200 with a packet id. Response validation (unknown kind / clarification without message) is already covered in /app/backend/tests/test_court_packets.py — not re-driven here to avoid re-modeling the judge/token access flow.
- Court e2e (test_iter56_court_walkthrough.py, unmodified): finalize-without-signature -> 400; submit-with-include_legal_report before finalize -> 400; after finalize + statement ready + attest + include_legal_report -> 200 with legal_report_included=true and 64-char legal_sha256; judge GET /court-dashboard/cases/{ref_id} contains statement.legal_summary with 5-row scale_table, placement={a:2,b:3,joint:2}, and growth.a[0].met=true; professional-report PDF text and public sample PDF caption both correct.

Admin routes could not be exercised: mattsossi@bsossi.com login returns 401 on preview because the seed_admin() resync path is gated by `password_reset_by_user` (server.py:275) and that flag is currently True for the owner account (the owner has changed the password themselves). ADMIN_PASSWORD env is therefore ignored. This is a memory-of-record env condition, not a refactor regression — /api/admin/professionals, /pending-professionals, /judges and POST /api/admin/professionals are all imported into the /api router (admin_routes.py), so the routes exist; they simply require a login this test suite cannot obtain. Main agent action: either (a) have the owner reset the admin password via the UI and update /app/memory/test_credentials.md, or (b) temporarily set ADMIN_PASSWORD_RESYNC=1 in backend/.env and restart to force reseed, then unset.
action_items: Preview admin login is broken for the seeded ADMIN_PASSWORD because the owner previously reset the password (users.password_reset_by_user=True gates seed_admin resync). Not a regression, but blocks admin route testing. Coordinate with owner to reset via forgot-password flow OR flip ADMIN_PASSWORD_RESYNC=1 once and restart.
critical_code_review_comments: cron_jobs._cron_accept accepts the JSON body but ignores its contents beyond envelope['run_id']; that is fine — but the endpoint requires a body (raises 400 'Invalid request body' on empty POST). If any real cron platform sends an empty body they will 400 with no clue. Consider `envelope = await request.json() if request.headers.get('content-length','0') != '0' else {}` — cosmetic.
court_messages Threads.post silently truncates text to 4000 chars without warning the caller; downstream AI summary uses last 30 messages so this is safe, just undocumented in the API contract.

court_packets create requires `cover_letter` to be 'at least a few sentences' (server-side length gate) but the router doesn't return a JSON field so clients can only match on the string. Consider `code:'cover_letter_too_short'` for structured error handling.

server.py:275 seed_admin: the `password_reset_by_user` gate can leave a preview environment locked out of admin if the owner rotated password on prod. Adding an explicit `ADMIN_PASSWORD_RESYNC=1` bypass is good, but the flag docs should live near /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Consider a `/api/admin/seed-status` diagnostic that returns whether resync would apply (behind an existing admin session).

success_rate.backend: 100% of executed (26/26 passed, 4 admin skipped by env)

test_credentials: casekit fixtures create t_*@example.com professionals/parents/judges; conftest.py purges them at session end. Admin mattsossi@bsossi.com/CoParents2026! from /app/memory/test_credentials.md does NOT work on preview (see action items).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter57_refactor_regression.py -o addopts= -v (pytest.ini has xdist -n auto that trips the module-scoped fixtures; disable addopts). Cron secret is sent as `Authorization: Bearer $WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET` with a JSON body (empty {} works). Integrations header is `X-Integration-Key`. Court message field is `text` not `body`. Court packet creation requires cover_letter >= a few sentences and attest=true. If admin login is required, first fix the ADMIN_PASSWORD reset situation (see action items). iter56 walkthrough is the source of truth for the court E2E happy-path.
